instructions: Which medRxiv subject category is this preprint posted under?
labels_source: author-written: medRxiv publishes subject names only; one neutral definition per category written once and frozen in this script (DEFINITIONS).

author_written_definitions.Epidemiology: Research on the distribution and determinants of disease and health outcomes in populations.
author_written_definitions.Public and Global Health: Research on protecting and improving the health of communities and populations, locally and worldwide.
author_written_definitions.Neurology: Research on disorders of the brain, spinal cord and nervous system.
author_written_definitions.Health Informatics: Research on the use of data, digital tools and information systems in health and health care.
author_written_definitions.Infectious Diseases (except HIV/AIDS): Research on diseases caused by pathogens such as bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites, other than HIV/AIDS.
author_written_definitions.Psychiatry and Clinical Psychology: Research on mental disorders and their psychological and psychiatric assessment and treatment.
author_written_definitions.Genetic and Genomic Medicine: Research on the role of genes, genetic variation and genomic data in human disease and its care.
author_written_definitions.Cardiovascular Medicine: Research on diseases of the heart and blood vessels.
author_written_definitions.Health Systems and Quality Improvement: Research on how health services are organised and delivered, and on improving their quality and safety.
author_written_definitions.Radiology and Imaging: Research on medical imaging methods and their use in diagnosis and treatment.
author_written_definitions.Obstetrics and Gynecology: Research on pregnancy, childbirth and the female reproductive system.
author_written_definitions.Nutrition: Research on diet, food intake and nutritional status in relation to health.
author_written_definitions.HIV/AIDS: Research on HIV infection and AIDS.
author_written_definitions.Health Economics: Research on costs, resource use and economic evaluation in health and health care.
author_written_definitions.Pediatrics: Research on the health and medical care of infants, children and adolescents.
author_written_definitions.Endocrinology: Research on hormonal and metabolic disorders, including diabetes mellitus.
author_written_definitions.Health Policy: Research on laws, policies and regulations that shape health and health care.
author_written_definitions.Sexual and Reproductive Health: Research on sexual health, fertility, contraception and reproduction.
author_written_definitions.Geriatric Medicine: Research on the health and medical care of older adults.

option_label_note: Option labels are the API category strings in title case; 'hiv aids' -> 'HIV/AIDS', 'infectious diseases' -> 'Infectious Diseases (except HIV/AIDS)' (the medRxiv site's subject name). meta.category keeps the raw API string.
text_edits: State = title + abstract from the API, verbatim except whitespace collapse and removal of a leading 'Abstract'/'Abstract/Summary'/'Summary' label. JATS section headings run into the text in the API (e.g. 'BackgroundWe ...'); left as-is (no edits, ND-safe).
uncertain: Spec said DOI 10.1101/2026.*; medRxiv now issues new DOIs under 10.64898/2026.*, so both prefixes are accepted (version 1, posted date >= 2026-06-01).
Licence 'cc0_ng' (CC0, apparently a no-copyright/government variant) is not in the spec's keep list and was dropped, as were empty licence strings.
Some API records have version '0' (listed but not version 1); dropped by the version==1 rule.
Category is chosen by the submitting authors on medRxiv, so some items could plausibly fit another listed category (e.g. Epidemiology vs Public and Global Health).
